character.description: Approved SD character in a new eight-pose right-facing sprint

run.action: Draw eight NEW and distinct hand-crafted running poses from the accepted character, not copies of the reference's limbs. Maintain three-quarter screen-right view and consistent head and torso proportions. Frame 1: character-right foot lands forward, character-left knee folds behind; opposite arms counter-swing. Frame 2: right leg supports while left knee drives forward; elbows bend. Frame 3: right foot pushes off, left knee passes hip; opposite arms exchange. Frame 4: airborne stride toward left-foot contact, both shoes visibly separated from ground. Frames 5-8 repeat those phases with character-left foot landing and character-right knee driving. Arms alternate opposite to the leading leg. Keep two visibly separate legs and two anatomically attached arms in every pose, one consistent ground line at contacts, a clear airborne arc, and a seamless 8-to-1 loop.

style: Match the supplied Run character exactly: same black hair silhouette, laughing closed-eye face, glasses, red shirt, necklace, blue jeans, black-and-white shoes, colors, outline density, and pixel size. New arm and leg poses only. Keep pose scale consistent and retain one character per frame.
